name: Shijiazhuang Kelin Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Shijiazhuang Kelin Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing industry in China and internationally. The company offers substation automation products, including microcomputer protection measurement and control device, substation integrated automation system, DC power supply system, and smart integrated power system; power distribution automation products, such as smart distribution platform, fault indicators, feeder terminal units, distribution terminal units, and transformer terminal units; and advanced metering infrastructure products, including A.M.I platform, prepaid and post-paid smart meters, and data concentrators.
